content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Nashville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience hours. Review PMI's specific education and work-hour thresholds before enrolling. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify your eligibility during a free consultation.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course delivered nationwide. Attend interactive sessions on your schedule, ask questions in real time, and receive official completion documentation. All contact hours are earned through our synchronous online classroom.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP® credential application with your education and experience records. Pay the PMI exam fee through their portal. Application review typically takes several business days.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, practice tests, and review sessions to reinforce core competencies and boost your confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. You may test at a public center or via remote proctoring.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle through project-management education, volunteer work, or other approved activities. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to remain certified and competitive in Nashville's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
